addAPlaylistURLChecksStart: Add a playlist URL — checks start right away.
hdrHint: A picture of high dynamic range: HDR is the PQ curve (HDR10, Dolby Vision), HLG the hybrid one. Read from the video header. To find such streams type HDR or HLG into the search.
importListHelp: An IPTV list (.m3u with #EXTINF), plain addresses one per line, or lines of “name;address”. Names and groups are taken from the list; addresses that are checked already are skipped.
importSummary: Addresses in the list: {total}. New: {fresh}, checked already: {existing}, unsuitable: {invalid}.
streamWillBeDeletedTogetherWith: Stream “{name}” will be deleted together with its history: metrics, incidents and the segment journal. This cannot be undone.
